An '''unidentified Zabrak''' was a member of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] was one of the many brought forward by [[Viscus/Legends|Brother Viscus]] to appear in front of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] for her selection of capable potential candidates to aid in her plan to get revenge against Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. This Zabrak made it past the initial selection and along with five other Zabraks fought Ventress in her first challenge, the test of arms. He was killed by Ventress when he attacked her with his dual axes, only to get stabbed in the stomach by her [[Pike/Legends|Pike]].
